transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

I’ve gotten really slowed down. At work, I can sit staring at one audit workpaper for twenty minutes before I can even make myself move my hand to type. People have started noticing that I’m not keeping up.
Alongside feeling slowed down, how has your mood been lately?
Most days I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest. It’s like the day is already lost before I even get out of bed.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About seven months now—since my husband stopped working after the downsizing.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before in your life?
I’m not sure. I don’t remember having a stretch like this before.
Have you ever had a period of time when you felt unusually energized or wired, completely different from your normal self?
I don’t think so. I can’t remember ever feeling unusually energized or wired like that.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in doing the things you usually enjoy?
Yes. I used to plan hikes, take photos, cook on Sundays, and volunteer at the library. Now they just feel like things on a checklist—I don’t really care enough to start them.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions, or have you noticed any changes in your physical health?
No, I haven’t been diagnosed with anything medical, and I haven’t noticed any major changes in my physical health.
How has your sleep been over these past few months?
I’m not really sure what to say about it. I haven’t paid close attention to my sleep over the past few months.
Have you been having feelings of worthlessness, or feeling like you're blaming yourself for things?

Yes. I feel like I’ve already ruined us financially, even though my husband shows me the bank balance and says we’re okay. And at work, my manager tells me my job isn’t in danger, but I’m sure the firm is quietly building a case against me because I’m incompetent.
